Name: Tiny Greenhouse
Author: inmognito
Description:
A Content Patcher mod that replaces the standard greenhouse with a miniature greenhouse with space for only 30 crops.  Perfect for challenge runs and smaller farm maps.

Recommended for use with [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/8203]Greenhouse Entry Begone[/url].


[b]Please note:
[/b][list]
[*]To use the tiny greenhouse, the config needs to be switched on when you create the new save, and keep it on whenever you play that save.  You can't change the size of an existing greenhouse either by installing or deleting the mod.
[*]Once you have your tiny greenhouse set up on a save, deleting the mod will leave you completely unable to access the vanilla greenhouse for
that save. (I'm working on this)
[*]There is a config that will let you disable the tiny greenhouse mod. This will let you play saves with normal sized greenhouses without needing to uninstall

[*]Compatible with Medieval Buildings if you disable the greenhouse in their config, and Flower Valley if you disable the farm buildings in their config.  I can't find a way to set it up with other farm building graphical mods at present.

[*]When moving the greenhouse the entry squares will show as being where they would occur for a full size greenhouse. However, once moved, they return to the correct position. If you're using Greenhouse Entry Begone they will vanish entirely.  However, this does mean that you need to clear more space than you  need before moving the greenhouse into position.

[/list]
